ST and optional exit-code variants are observations only. Direct-local disposable App; no command exit-event payload, real shell, remote or mux, E/P record, other platforms, common-harness or stock-score claim. OSC 9 and OSC 777/99 evidence is from the separately identified, independently revalidated predecessor run.
